last_session.detail: They assumed the treasure lay at one of the marked locations, but all the surrounding land was unknown to them.
last_session.text: The party reached Brandonsford at sunset, following a treasure map whose marked places they did not recognize.

last_session.detail: Reginald said the Clurichen is up to no good and that wherever it goes, they should stay away.
last_session.text: Reginald the frog warned Dr. Uriah that a trickster Clurichen comes into town from the riverbanks nightly.

last_session.detail: Dunk preferred solitude to the inns and went to scavenge at the farm on the edge of town. Gill's legend: Sir Brandon met a fairy in the woods who gave him a magic sword; he and his friends killed a dragon that had terrorized the town for weeks. The town was named after him, they were knighted, then all left, and Brandon died. That dragon was dragged through town and ripped apart hundreds of years ago. Gill assumes the current dragon is a different one. Gill saw the current dragon and sent his three sons after it. Dunk asked to sleep in the barn and think over the offer; they drank from Gill's still while Gill shared gossip.
last_session.text: Dunk spent the night drinking with Farmer Gill, who told him how Sir Brandon slew a dragon long ago.

last_session.detail: The bounty requires killing the dragon and dragging its body into town; Eric called it the first of many problems he has. Eric cited George, a woodsman who lost an arm to the dragon and described it as a black dragon, not a big one. Sir Phidipaldi slapped Eric with his glove when Eric defended George's account; the flustered Eric only said Sir Phidipaldi was more skilled at adventure.
last_session.text: Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold for the dragon. Sir Phidipaldi slapped him and challenged him to a duel at dawn, which Eric did not accept.

last_session.detail: Uriah brought Ned a Fox Tail Brew; Ned recognized him as a Dagonite. Uriah claimed to be a scholar of folk remedies and lore looking for work with his crew. Ned's terms are under What could help; he also offered 5 gold back per kill on a night of at least ten kills if he could do what he wanted with the victims.
last_session.text: Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp, offered to hire on with Dr. Uriah, who said he would think about it.

last_session.detail: Quinn says his good stock is gone each morning, with half the glasses empty or knocked over, so he waters down what little he has. He blames Bentley because Bentley's Fox Tail Brew is so popular. Quinn offered 100 gold and proposed a fake shipment, which Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage.
last_session.text: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn of the Golden Egg catch whoever empties his ale each night.

open.text: Find the treasure shown on the party's map.

open.detail: Sir Phidipaldi said they would talk to the Reeve, then denied the dragon exists and challenged Eric to a duel.
open.text: Kill the black dragon and drag its body into town for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold. The party has not accepted the offer.

open.detail: The ale disappears from the Golden Egg.
open.text: Catch whoever empties Quinn's good ale each night and collect Quinn's 100 gold.

open.detail: Lady Hilda is a seasoned fighter in chain mail with a shield.
open.text: If the party pays Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter, she will join them to hunt the dragon. She won't go alone.

open.detail: Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.
open.text: If Dr. Uriah pays Drop Dead Ned 100 gold a week, Ned and his killer wasp will do any job. Ned insists on killing people with the wasp.

open.detail: Quinn brings bottles, they fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering ale to the Golden Egg.
open.text: If Sir Phidipaldi stages a fake ale delivery to the Golden Egg, it may draw out whoever takes Quinn's ale.
Where are the places marked on the party's map, and where is the treasure?

open.detail: Half the glasses are left empty or knocked over. Quinn believes Bentley is responsible.
open.text: Who or what empties Quinn's good ale each night?
Where does the black dragon lurk outside Brandonsford?

open.detail: Bentley's restocking shipment is a week overdue.
open.text: What happened to Bentley's shipment, and why has nothing reached Brandonsford in months?

open.detail: Sir Brandon's dragon was killed centuries ago and none has appeared since.
open.text: Where did this new dragon come from?

open.detail: Gill's sons are hunting the dragon now.
open.text: The black dragon tore off George the woodsman's arm and may maim or kill others, including Gill's three sons.
